description: This file provides date and time utility functions for the Notesnook project, including formatting dates, generating week groups from timestamps, and handling various date/time formats and options.

methods.name: getWeekGroupFromTimestamp
methods.description: Generates a string representing the week range (start to end) for a given timestamp.

methods.name: getTimeFormat
methods.description: Returns the appropriate time format string based on the specified format ('12-hour' or 24-hour).

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a date according to specified options such as date format, time format, and timezone.
